title: Lake Tahoe Guided ATV Tour to a Hidden Alpine Lake
includes: Shuttle transportation to and from the trailhead
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the Tahoe backcountry on a guided ATV adventure designed for all experience levels. After a scenic shuttle ride to the trailhead, guests will receive a beginner-friendly safety briefing and guided practice session before heading onto the trails.

Ride through scenic forest terrain and mountain landscapes on the way to a beautiful hidden alpine lake tucked away in the Tahoe wilderness. Along the way, enjoy off-road riding, fresh mountain air, and incredible photo opportunities surrounded by nature.

Once at the lake, guests can relax by the water, cool off with a swim during warmer months, take photos, or enjoy snacks and lunch brought from home before riding back through the Tahoe backcountry.

This experience is beginner-friendly, guided from start to finish, and designed to offer a fun and memorable outdoor adventure in South Lake Tahoe.

Drivers must be 18 years or older. No drivers license required.
